target.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve bot-authored quote replies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a user replied to an OpenClaw-authored WhatsApp message, the gateway could not reconstruct that outbound message as a self-authored quote. WhatsApp Desktop then lost the native reply bubble.

Refs #91445.

## Why This Change Was Made

The repaired branch records the existing bounded quote metadata immediately after Baileys accepts an outbound send. It stores only `fromMe` and preview text; pinned Baileys derives the quoted self participant from its `userJid`, so the earlier self-JID/LID synthesis was removed.

## User Impact

Replies to bot-authored WhatsApp messages retain the native quoted-reply context, including the Desktop reply bubble.

## Evidence

- Quoted-message suite: 5 tests passed.
- Actual outbound-cache regression: 1 passed, 80 unrelated tests skipped.
- Pinned Baileys contract regression proves `fromMe` quotes derive participant from `userJid`.
- Fresh Codex autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Exact prepared head: `2b2770b36955cad2abffee34cc9dcb480c4dbd64`.
- Gap: no live WhatsApp Desktop swipe-reply capture was available; hosted exact-head CI remains the merge gate.
